meta.description: ORVIBO Q3 eye-care downlight: a recessed, full-spectrum, anti-glare smart LED for living room ceilings that draws soft arcs of light on the wall and gives natural light that is gentler on your eyes.
sec2.title:
World-class industrial design,
automotive-grade craft, solid quality
sec2.info: Designed by a team that won all four major design awards
sec2.info2:
A leader in smart homes where technology meets design, ORVIBO won the 2017 iF GOLD AWARD, the “Oscar” of industrial design,
has since swept all four major international design awards, and now brings a downlight that breaks with tradition.
sec3.title: Overworked eyes need gentler light
sec4.left3: A lack of red light in the spectrum is one of the culprits behind myopia. Adding 650–900 nm red light can boost mitochondrial function and energize the eyes, helping ease declining eyesight.
sec4.tips: * References: “Myopia Prevention and Control in Adolescents: From Research Evidence to Clinical Practice”; Chinese Academy of Sciences, “Three Minutes of Red Light a Day Improves Declining Eyesight”
sec5.left2: Better sleep, no eye strain at work or study
sec5.left3: Gentler on the eyes, it also supports melatonin production for better sleep.
sec5.tips: Passed TÜV Rheinland's blue light test to IEC 62471:2006.
sec6.info2: Premium light makes your furniture look its best
sec6.info3:
Rf 97 color fidelity and Rg 100 color gamut bring out your furniture's true colors;
R15 up to 99 renders skin tones naturally, so selfies at home look even better.
sec6.tips: *Data from ORVIBO lab tests; results may differ under other test conditions.
sec7.left2: UGR < 8: no glare, even looking up
sec7.left3: A deep anti-glare free-form COB optic precisely controls where the light goes, and KR micro-prisms make it smoother and more even, with no stray light and no glare.
sec7.tips: *Data from ORVIBO lab tests; results may differ under other test conditions.
sec8.left:
Far beyond the norm,
no visible flicker
sec8.left2: No flicker when you film at home
sec8.left3: A constant-current IC driver adjusts voltage and frequency on the fly, so light output never fluctuates and there is no visible flicker.
sec9.info: Elegant arcs of light your neighbors will envy
sec9.info2:
A crisp, well-shaped beam and soft, even wall washing
with no stray halos give your space perfect depth.
sec10.title: Three color temperatures for the mood you want
sec11.info: 25° watch-dial tilt: spotlight or wall wash
sec12.title: Built with automotive-grade craft, made to last
